notation: Token groups components consume. Values live in the sources; the DTCG files are generated. `panda` lists paths into the Panda theme: tokens.<category>[.<group>] and semanticTokens.<category>[.<group>] from tokens/index.ts, conditions.<name> from the preset. Tests check that every path exists and that every Panda token category and condition is covered by some entry.

color-roles.summary: Semantic color roles per scheme, from Spectrum: bg, fg, border, overlay, inverse, backdrop, selected; primary, secondary, neutral, critical, warning, success and info each with solid, solidHover, subtle, subtleHover, border, fg and steps 1-12; data 1-6; focusRing; and the scheme-aware shadows (sm, md) colored by the shadow role.

type-roles.summary: Faces (fonts.*), weights, line heights and tracking, and the textStyle roles built on them.

font-sizes.summary: fontSizes.<step> (xs … 5xl) are type-scale steps from the base 10px + u: base × ratio^step, so they follow the theme unit, --ui-type-ratio and [size] subtrees. No fixed rem scale.

motion.summary: durations.<spring> and easings.<spring> (quick, smooth, snappy, bouncy), used as a pair, solved live in CSS from --ui-spring-<spring>-duration|bounce and the global --ui-motion-scale and --ui-motion-bounce; semantic intents durations/easings.<intent> (feedback, toggle, reveal, emphasis) run the spring --ui-intent-<intent> selects (0-3). Derived --motion-* variables (styles/motion.ts) are registered as <number>. Components use the intents.

geometry.summary: Theme geometry parameters (--ui-unit, --ui-border, --ui-radius-scale, container pad/gap) and the derived per-element variables; the Panda length tokens below are built on them.

spacing.summary: spacing.<n> = n·u for n in 0, 0.5 … 24, computed where used from the inherited --ui-unit, so it follows the theme unit and [size] subtrees.

container-ladder.summary: Container spacing per level (group … page): pad.<level> and gap.<level> are the theme's --ui-pad-<level> / --ui-gap-<level> in u; inset.<level> is the padding inside a border, max(0, pad − B) with B = min(border, u/2).

sizes.summary: sizes.<n> = n·u on the same steps as spacing, plus keywords: full, min, max, fit (intrinsic sizes) and prose (65ch).

radii.summary: radii sm, md, lg, xl = 1, 1.5, 2, 3 u × --ui-radius-scale; none (0) and full (9999px) are fixed.

borders-shadows.summary: borderWidths thin (1px) and thick (2px), fixed; shadows are scheme-aware semantic tokens colored by the Spectrum shadow role, × shadow-strength: the base sm and md, and the elevation levels raised, floating, modal and card (tokens/elevation, docs/specs/elevation.md); colors.elevation.panel | card | overlay are the level fills mixed toward the page by surface-contrast.

conditions.summary: Panda conditions: the scheme (_osDark, _dark, _light, in preset.ts), _keyboard, and the state vocabulary keyed on the data-* state contract (Base UI names) that both renderers set on the same hosts: _checked, _unchecked, _indeterminate, _disabled, _enabled, _readOnly, _required, _invalid, _valid, _dirty, _touched, _filled, _focused, _busy, _pressed, _popupOpen, _open, _closed, _highlighted, _selected, _dragging, _complete, _progressing.
